title: Process Engineer - Semiconductor Processes
description: Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 Role Overview We are looking for a Process Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Process Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. The role will have a strong focus on dry etching processes, particularly ICP and RIE, as well as PECVD and metal evaporation. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. Key Responsibilities Process Development & Industrialization Develop, optimize and stabilize semiconductor fabrication processes, with a primary focus on ICP / RIE dry etching, PECVD deposition and metal evaporation. Validate and qualify new fabrication equipment and associated processes.&

title: Lab IT Solution Engineer
description:

JTG Consulting Group , LLC is a certified minority-owned business and an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. Lab IT Solution Engineer

Job Summary

The Lab IT Solution Engineer reports directly to the Chief Services Officer and is focused on supporting the Sales organization. The Lab IT Solution Engineer serves as a technical and solutions-focused partner within JTG Consulting Group ’s sales process, helping prospective and existing clients translate laboratory, technology, and operational needs into well-defined solutions.

The role applies laboratory IT expertise, problem-solving, and strong communication skills to support client discovery, scoping, estimating, proposal and Statement of Work (SOW) development, and the transition of awarded work to Services. Inside Out is a US-based premium placement firm matching executive assistants-and increasingly other high-value roles-with American founders and executives who pay a premium for speed and quality. Demand is completely solved through our paid advertising and in-house sales team, meaning you will never have to find a client. Your job is to run and grow the machine that delivers for them.

This is a senior seat reporting directly to the founder. You will have true ownership of the delivery side of the business and share in the financial upside as we scale.

What You Will Own

• Time-to-fill: Managing the timeline from signed client to placed candidate.
• The Bench: Maintaining a pipeline of fully screened, interview-ready candidates for our highest-volume roles.
• Team Performance: Leading an operations coordinator, recruiters/screeners, and sourcing support while establishing productivity standards and scorecards.
• Quality Control: Ensuring placement quality and 90-day retention (replacements come directly out of our margin).
• Process Optimization: Managing our ATS pipeline (JazzHR), sourcing channels, and overall candidate experience.
• Scale & Expansion: Driving more placements per month without quality slipping, and expanding the roles we place as the business grows.

Your First 90 Days
• Audit the current pipeline, bench, and screening processes to identify what is working and what isn't.
• Set the fill-speed and quality standards the team will be held to, putting scorecards in place to track them.
• Rebuild the candidate bench so a signed client is never waiting on sourcing.
• Establish a daily and weekly operating rhythm that keeps every open search moving.

Who You Are
• 5-10+ years in recruitment with real leadership experience (ran an agency, branch, or perm desk with P&L or billings responsibility).
• Experienced in managing recruiters and holding a firm quality bar under speed pressure.
• Highly data-driven: you know your placements per month, fill times, and fall-off rates cold.
• Calm, structured, decisive, and ruthless with prioritization-you don't drop balls.
• Comfortable working US-aligned hours remotely.
• Proficient in leveraging AI tools to screen, source, and move faster.
• A builer at heart: comfortable rewriting broken processes or scaling a half-built function.
• Experience placing into US, UK, or Australian clients is strongly preferred.

Why You Should Join Us
• No Red Tape: Work directly with the founder. Decisions get made in a conversation, giving you a direct line to strategy and hiring.
• Zero Client Acquisition: Inherit a paid-ads and sales engine that already produces signed clients so you can focus entirely on delivery.
• Massive Upside: Beyond base and performance bonuses, this role is on a path to a profit-share incentive. Build the machine and share in what it produces.
• Premium Positioning: We charge top-of-market fees, allowing us to hire well, pay well, and maintain elite standards.
• Global & Remote: Join a 100+ person team across South Africa, the Philippines, and Latin America with no commute and US-dollar earnings.
• Room to Build: Shape how our role expansion happens rather than inheriting someone else's playbook.

How to Apply
Along with your CV, provide a video introduction telling us:

1. How many placements per month your desk or team made.

2. Your average time-to-fill.

3. The biggest operational problem you fixed in a recruitment business.

Note: Candidates who know their numbers cold will move fastest through our process. Originally posted on Himalayas

In this role, you will take technical ownership of designing, building, and extending mission-critical SAP applications-leveraging modern development paradigms such as the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and Core Data Services (CDS).

You will drive modern, upgrade-stable SAP development by adhering strictly to "Clean Core" architectural guidelines. Rather than relying on legacy, modification-heavy ABAP patterns, you will build side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP, expose optimized OData services, push heavy calculations down to the in-memory SAP HANA database, and deliver intuitive user experiences via SAP Fiori.

 

What we’re looking for:

 

•
5+ years of SAP development experience, with at least 3 years dedicated to S/4HANA, featuring expert command of Object-Oriented ABAP (OO-ABAP), New ABAP Syntax (7.4+), and RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model).

•
Advanced proficiency authoring complex Core Data Services (CDS) Views, parameters, associations, access controls (DCL), and ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP) for code push-down performance.

•
Extensive experience creating and exposing OData v2/v4 services via SAP Gateway (SEGW) or RAP business services for UI consumption and third-party cloud integrations.

•
Practical experience developing custom SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications or configuring Fiori Elements apps using CDS annotations.

•
Firm understanding of modern SAP extensibility frameworks, including On-Stack Developer Extensibility (Embedded ABAP / Steampunk) and Side-by-Side Extensibility using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

•
Proven ability to trace, profile, and optimize ABAP/HANA execution using Runtime Analysis (SAT), ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC), SQL Trace (ST05), and SQL Monitor (SQLM).

 

Nice-to-have skills:

 

•
Hands-on experience developing side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP using Node.js/CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) or ABAP Cloud.

•
Background in legacy-to-S/4HANA code remediation, custom code analysis (CCA), and migration projects.

•
Exposure to Event-Driven Architecture using SAP Event Mesh or Kafka integrations.

•
Knowledge of standard SAP S/4HANA business process modules (FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP).

 

Responsibilities:

 

•
Architect, build, and maintain high-performing transactional and analytical SAP applications using ABAP RAP, CDS views, and AMDP.

•
Build upgrade-stable enhancements and side-by-side extensions, strictly minimizing legacy modifications to protect core system stability.

•
Design and expose secure OData endpoints to power SAP Fiori user interfaces, mobile apps, and enterprise cloud integrations.

•
Perform automated code checks (ATC), enforce clean code standards, conduct peer code reviews, and optimize legacy custom code for S/4HANA compatibility.

•
Collaborate closely with SAP functional consultants, enterprise architects, and BTP specialists to translate business requirements into technical solution specifications.

 

 

What we offer:

 

Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments

Short Description
The Data Exchange Developer III will be part of the IT data exchange group and will be required to work closely with various departments within the organization.
The individual analyzes, designs, documents, tests, troubleshoots and coordinates implementation of application and device interfaces.
Interact with business owners and IT colleagues for discovery build and testing.
Works with application and interface analysts as well as various third parties to translate interface requirements into technical specifications.
The position holder will be responsible for providing guidance to junior staff as well as plan and help manage architect, artifacts, compliance and upgrade software.

Application data interfaces are used to connect applications at the data transaction level, usually in real-time. Sharing data electronically eliminates redundant entry of source data and reduces the opportunity for keying errors.
Device data interfaces are used to capture vital signs and other bio-data from patient monitoring medical devices and transfer that data into the EHR for review and recording in real-time.
This reduces the effort required to record data as well as the opportunity for keying errors.
Bridges - responsible for the operation of the (Bridges) interface toolkit of the Epic EHR. Bridges is one of the modules that enable data to be transported into and out of Epic, both application and device data.
FHIR - responsible for implementing and assisting in FHIR adoption strategy.

About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $136M ARR and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Red Team Security Engineer to join our team!

About the Role

The Red Team Security Engineer continuously validates whether vulnerabilities, configurations, identities, applications, infrastructure, and AI-enabled systems can be exploited by realistic adversaries. The role combines traditional offensive security with AI-assisted and agentic adversary emulation to validate exposure and continuously improve defensive controls.

Key Responsibilities

• Emulate external attackers, malicious insiders, compromised identities, and autonomous adversarial agents.

• Validate whether vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses identified are reachable and practically exploitable.

• Develop and execute realistic attack paths across web applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, identity systems, endpoints, and other enterprise services.

• Use AI-assisted and agentic techniques for reconnaissance, vulnerability analysis, attack-path discovery, and controlled offensive testing.

• Test AI applications and agents for prompt injection, tool abuse, excessive privilege, identity compromise, and other emerging attack classes.

• Validate compensating controls and mitigations before or after deployment.

• Conduct purple-team exercises with Security Analytics and Security Operations to validate telemetry, detection, and response effectiveness.

• Translate offensive findings into actionable improvements to architecture, configuration, detections, and response capabilities.

Qualifications

• Experience in red teaming, penetration testing, adversary emulation, or offensive security engineering.

• Strong web, API, cloud, identity, operating-system, and network security fundamentals.

• Experience validating practical exploitability and developing realistic attack paths.

• Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK and modern adversary techniques.

• Familiarity with OWASP Top 10 for LLM, OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, and MITRE ATLAS.

• Scripting or software-development experience.

• Experience safely using automation or AI-assisted techniques in offensive-security workflows.

• Experience assessing cloud-native or AI-enabled systems, conducting purple-team exercises, or simulating autonomous adversaries is preferred.

At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you're reading. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Learning, developing, and growing are key parts of our culture. We're eager to meet people who believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in various ways. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. That’s why diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. title: Commission-Only Sales Representative (Remote, South Africa)
description:
QuickTeam helps US businesses grow by placing high-quality offshore talent - trained, vetted, and ready to work - at a fraction of the cost of hiring locally. We handle recruiting, onboarding, and client support from end to end. We're growing fast and looking for closers who want to be paid for what they actually produce.
How this is different
Most commission roles pay you once per deal and move on. This one keeps paying. Every month a client's virtual assistant is working, you earn. Close a client once, and that account generates income for as long as the VA stays - and our VAs typically stay for years.
You're also not starting from scratch. We have a dedicated lead specialist who continuously researches, qualifies, and contextualizes leads for you, so you're always working a warm pipeline. Your job is to close, not to build a list.
What you get

• Warm, contextualized leads - a dedicated member of our team constantly builds and prepares your pipeline. You come in warm, not cold.

• Recurring income - your commission is tied to hours billed by the VAs you place. Active placements mean monthly income, month after month, with no additional effort on your part.

• Long-term compounding upside - clients who stay for two or three years keep paying you the whole time. Your book of business grows and compounds.

• Uncapped earnings in USD - no territory limits, no income ceiling.

• Full tools and access - CRM, dialer, email, and everything you need to work deals effectively.

• Backend handled for you - we manage recruiting, onboarding, and ongoing client delivery so you stay focused on selling.

What earnings look like
Because commission is tied to hours worked rather than a flat placement fee, income compounds as your book grows. A modest base of a few active long-term clients generates meaningful recurring monthly income in USD - and that base keeps building as you close more. The commission structure is competitive and discussed in full during the interview.
How it works

• You apply and we walk you through the model, the leads, and the comp.

• We get you set up with tools and access.

• You start working leads and closing deals.

• You get paid - and keep getting paid every month your clients stay active.

Requirements
What we're looking for

• Proven B2B sales or closing experience - staffing, services, SaaS, or similar preferred

• Exceptional spoken English is essential. This is a phone-first sales role - you will be cold calling and closing US business owners directly. Your voice, fluency, and natural confidence on a call are your primary tools. South African English is highly regarded in the US market and a genuine advantage in this role; what matters is that you sound assured, articulate, and easy to understand from the first word.

• Willing to work US EST hours - South Africa is well-positioned for this. EST is only 6 hours behind SAST, meaning a standard SA afternoon covers a full US morning.

• Comfortable working leads by phone, email, and LinkedIn

• Self-motivated and disciplined - you don't need a manager over your shoulder

• Experience selling to or working with US-based clients is a strong advantage

• Coachable, organized, and consistent in follow-up

• Hungry for uncapped, USD-denominated, performance-based income

This role is not for

• Anyone expecting a base salary or guaranteed hourly pay

• People who need constant supervision or hand-holding

• Reps looking for a 9-to-5 with a predictable paycheck

description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

You’ll bring structure to how we plan, deliver and measure enablement, from tracking OKRs and roadmaps to coordinating the enablement calendar, launches and certifications. You’ll also help keep the team aligned on priorities, manage cross-functional dependencies and use reporting to understand what’s working and where we can improve. Working closely with the Sales Enablement lead and partners across GTM, RevOps, Product Marketing and People, you’ll help turn priorities into well-run programmes that meet the needs of the business.

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys bringing order to complex projects, delivering engaging training and finding practical, creative ways to solve problems.

title: Enterprise Data Architect
description:
Enterprise Data Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Enterprise Data Architect
Location:  100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type:  Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range:  $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required:  6+ years

Sponsorship:  U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Enterprise Data Architect to define and lead the architecture of our enterprise data platform, spanning ingestion, storage, processing, governance, and consumption layers. The role drives the strategic direction of data infrastructure, sets standards for data modeling and lifecycle management, and partners with data engineering, analytics, ML, and business stakeholders to deliver a coherent, scalable data foundation. The ideal candidate combines deep technical mastery of modern data platforms with strong architectural judgment, and has led data-platform programs of meaningful scope and complexity.

Key Responsibilities

• Define the target-state architecture of the enterprise data platform, including ingestion, storage, processing, and consumption layers.

• Establish standards for data modeling, schema evolution, partitioning, file formats, and storage organization.

• Architect lakehouse, warehouse, and streaming patterns leveraging technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi.

• Design end-to-end data pipelines that balance latency, cost, reliability, and maintainability across batch and streaming workloads.

• Lead the integration of governance, lineage, and catalog tools such as Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Unity Catalog, or DataHub.

• Define security architecture including row- and column-level controls, masking, encryption, and identity-aware access patterns.

• Partner with ML, BI, and product teams to ensure platform capabilities align with downstream consumption needs.

• Establish data contract and data product principles to drive ownership, quality, and decoupling between producers and consumers.

• Lead architecture reviews and provide guidance on pipeline and warehouse design proposals across teams.

• Drive cost optimization and capacity planning across the data platform estate.

• Design disaster recovery, multi-region, and high-availability strategies for critical data assets.

• Mentor data engineers and architects on platform standards and emerging best practices.

• Produce architecture artifacts including context diagrams, decision records, and reference patterns.

• Stay current with data platform research, vendor offerings, and open-source ecosystem developments.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

• Eight or more years of experience in data engineering, with significant time in architecture roles.

• Deep expertise across at least two major data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift.

• Strong understanding of lakehouse architectures, modern table formats, and streaming systems.

• Hands-on experience with Spark, Flink, or Kafka at production scale.

• Strong data modeling expertise across dimensional, normalized, and data-vault patterns.

• Experience implementing governance, lineage, and catalog capabilities.

• Solid grasp of cloud platforms, networking, identity, and cost optimization.

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Track record of leading large data platform initiatives across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with data mesh or data product architectures.

• Familiarity

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

You can read more about it in our blog https://building.nubank.com.br and get some insights into how we work.

- Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;

- Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;

- Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python, Databricks and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;

- Understand our products and interactions with other areas;

- Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;

- Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

- Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;

- Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;

- Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;

We’re a Seattle-area home-buying company backed by a proven national franchise system. We help homeowners facing difficult situations, from inherited properties to major repairs or financial challenges, find fast, fair and hassle-free solutions.
We set our team up to win. With proven sales systems, comprehensive training and a steady flow of warm leads, you can focus on what you do best: closing deals and earning based on your performance.
We believe work should be productive and fun. Our culture is built around:

• Transparency and authenticity

• Learning and personal growth

• Taking ownership

• Humor and having fun

• Helping each other succeed

• Treating people like people, not just leads

JOB SUMMARY
We’re seeking an ambitious Home Buying & Selling Specialist to join our Seattle team. This role is focused on helping property owners solve problems while negotiating and securing off-market real estate opportunities. Most of the work is done by phone. You’ll respond to inbound seller leads, build trust quickly, uncover motivation, present offers and guide sellers to a signed agreement. Once a seller agrees to a deal, you’ll visit the property to complete the process.
This is a remote role, but candidates must be located in the Seattle area.
During the launch phase, this role covers both acquisitions and dispositions. After a seller signs, you’ll coordinate the handoff to developer buyers using a buyer list we provide, with the owner’s support. As the team grows, disposition responsibilities will move to a dedicated hire so you can focus on acquisitions.
This is a professional sales role for someone who is highly competitive, disciplined, self-sufficient and motivated by performance-based compensation.
WHAT WE OFFER

• Compensation & Earnings Transparency

• Base Salary to Start: $3,000 per month for the first 3 months while you learn the system and lead volume ramps up

• Commission Structure: 6% commission, plus an additional 2% while you’re also handling disposition responsibilities

• On-Target Earnings: $120K to $150K annually, with no cap on earnings

• Mileage and gas reimbursement for site visits

• W-2 employee position

• Health, dental and vision benefits after 90 days

LEADS, TOOLS & SUPPORT

• Warm, inbound seller leads (no cold prospecting)

• Full training program, including online training, weekly team meetings and live sales coaching

• Proven sales process and CRM systems designed to minimize non-sales activities

• Buyer list and direct owner support for disposition work

• Flexible, results-focused schedule

• Predominantly remote, phone-based work (local site visits required)

• Opportunity to grow as the business expands across the Seattle area

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Respond promptly to inbound seller leads so that no lead goes unanswered

• Conduct high-volume phone calls to qualify seller motivation, timeline and pricing

• Lead discovery conversations, overcome objections and move sellers toward signed agreements

• Present offers by phone and negotiate terms with distressed-property owners

• Use our tools and training to evaluate deals and prepare offers

• Coordinate dispositions after signing, working with the owner to hand off deals to developer buyers from the provided buyer list

• Travel to properties to finalize deals with sellers

• Accurately input, manage and track all leads and deals in the CRM

• Communicate proactively with the owner, asking questions and following up right away

• Meet or exceed monthly contract volume and revenue targets tied directly to commission earnings

QUALIFICATIONS

• 2+ years of proven sales experience, with a track record of earning $100K+ in commission preferred

• Strong background in phone-based or consultative sales

• Excellent communication skills with a relationship-driven, empathetic approach to sellers in stressful situations

• Proven ability to close deals and hit performance targets

• Strong phone presence and orga

title: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend
description:
About Deploy
 
Deploy is an intelligence infrastructure platform that gives developers and enterprises access to open source and proprietary AI models. For leading open source LLMs, Deploy operates an optimized model inference engine that keeps costs and latency low while maintaining high throughout.  Deploy also offers a set of proprietary AI models that address challenges in content safety, AI & deepfake detection, sponsorship intelligence, and IP & publicity protection. Trusted by the world's largest and most innovative organizations, Deploy's solutions unlock high-performance AI model inference at production scale.

Deploy has raised more than $200M from leading investors, including Tomales Bay Capital, General Catalyst, 8VC, Glynn Capital, Bain & Company, Visa Ventures, and others. The company has more than 250 employees across offices in San Francisco, Seattle, New York, and Delhi.
 
About the Role
 
Frontend Engineers are an essential part of the Deploy Data and Deploy Enterprise products. Working closely with designers, product owners, and other engineers, we implement the user interfaces that define our core platforms. We leverage the latest web technologies such as React, Redux, Webpack, and ES6 to deliver innovative interfaces and rich user experiences. The team is small and fast moving, and you will be expected to iterate quickly and make software design decisions on product features. As a front-end engineer at Deploy, your breadth of skills paired with our bottom-up product process will give you as much autonomy and responsibility as you can handle. We are looking for technically-strong teammates who are passionate about frontend technologies and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Who We Are
 
We are a group of ambitious individuals who are passionate about creating a revolutionary AI company. At Deploy, you will have a steep learning curve and an opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest growing AI start-ups in San Francisco. The work you do here will have a noticeable and direct impact on the development of the company.
 
Thank you for your interest in Deploy and we hope to meet you soon!
 
The current expected base salary for this position ranges from $160,000 - $250,000. Actual compensation may vary depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the total compensation package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work; stock options may be offered in addition to the range provided here.
 
Employees are eligible to participate in a number of Company-sponsored benefits, including health, vision and dental insurance. Employees are also eligible to participate in a gym membership as part of our commitment to employee wellness. In addition, employees will be entitled to paid vacation in accordance with the Company's vacation policy.
 
Hired applicant may receive an equity grant in the form of an option to purchase stock in the future for a specified price.

Можливо, ти вже бачила(ив) наші спін-оффи - Avrora та Promova.

Зараз ми шукаємо Data Analyst в наш флагманський продукт JustDone - AI асистент для академічної аудиторії , який допомагає краще працювати з науковими роботами, навчатись і проводити глибинні дослідження. Ми віримо, що AI може суттєво змінити те, як люди навчаються та працюють з інформацією. Не через cheating, а через якісніший і глибший рісьорч, швидшу роботу з великими обсягами інформації та автоматизацію формальних і рутинних задач. Так у студентів і дослідників залишається більше часу на те, що справді має значення - мислення, навчання та власні ідеї.

Основна мета цієї ролі - перетворювати дані на інсайти та дієві рішення, які допомагають JustDone зростати.

Сьогодні JustDone це

• 3+ млн преміум користувачів;

• #1 позиція в США в ніші AI Writing Assistants;

• 90%+ одиниць контенту, створених користувачами, знаходять реальне застосування;

• понад 3 млн одиниць контенту, який генерується користувачами щомісяця;

• власні AI та NLP рішення: AI Detector, Text Humanization Engines, AI Research Assistant.

Твоє майбутнє середовище

Наша головна перевага - це люди. Ми працюємо з тими, хто щодня прагне до самовдосконалення та задає високу планку гри. Ти приєднаєшся до команди аналітики, яка допомагає бізнесу краще розуміти, що відбувається з продуктом, знаходити точки зростання та приймати сильніші рішення на основі даних, де щодня взаємодіятимеш з Танею Є., Танею М. та Владом.

Лідер напрямку - Сергій, BI & Analytics Lead. У роботі з Сергієм багато простору для самостійності: він не буде розкладати кожну задачу на кроки, натомість дасть можливість самому розібратися, поставити правильні питання та знайти найкраще рішення. Водночас Сергій завжди готовий підключитися там, де це справді потрібно.

У команді багато уваги приділяють тому, щоб аналітика не зводилася лише до цифр і звітів. Важливо розуміти, що саме відбулося, чому це сталося та як на це можна вплинути. Команда активно використовує AI та автоматизацію, щоб зменшувати кількість рутинних задач і давати аналітикам більше часу на складніші дослідження та пошук інсайтів.

Саме в цій ролі ти отримаєш

• Можливість впливати на розвиток аналітики та продукту - не просто працювати з готовими даними, а власноруч розвивати систему та втілювати свої ідеї.

• Велике поле для пошуку інсайтів - працювати з масштабними масивами даних і знаходити закономірності, які можуть впливати на бізнес-рішення.

• Роботу на стику аналітики та AI - взаємодіяти з NLP-командою, використовувати готові AI-рішення та долучатися до розвитку цього напрямку.

Твоя зона впливу

• Аналізувати маркетингові, продуктові та платіжні дані, знаходити точки зростання й формувати ідеї для розвитку продукту та залучення користувачів.

• Працювати з revenue stream management - аналізувати дохід, підписки, їхню ціну та тривалість, знаходити можливості для збільшення revenue та покращення окупності.

• Досліджувати продуктові метрики та їхні драйвери, щоб розуміти, що саме впливає на ключові бізнес-результати.

• Виявляти патерни поведінки користувачів, перетворювати їх на гіпотези та знаходити нові можливості для розвитку продукту.

• Будувати аналітичні репорти й дашборди, які допомагають командам бачити повну картину та приймати рішення на основі даних.

Для цього тобі знадобиться

•
Від 1 року комерційного досвіду в аналітиці - data (є значною перевагою), product, marketing або payment analytics.

• Впевнене володіння SQL та досвід роботи з BI-інструментами - Tableau, Power BI або аналогами.

• Розуміння принципів проведення та аналізу A/B-тестів.

• Досвід роботи з Python буде перевагою.

• Сильне аналітичне мислення та data-driven підхід - вміння глибоко дос

title: Model Based Software Engineer/Integrator
description:
Tech stack:

• Matlab, Simulink, C++17, Python, VS Code, IAR, Git, OOP paradigm, UML, Bacnet, Modbus, MP, Ethernet TCP/IP, NFC, ARM

Requirements:

• Strong debugging and integration skills

• Experience in Embedded SW Development (C/C++)

• Experience with Matlab/Simulink

• Matlab scripting (ideally OOP Matlab)

• Modeling / Generating code

• Hands-on experience with MCUs

• Proactive approach to solving complex integration challenges

• Code review experience

Nice to have:

• Experienced in using AI tools in day-to-day workflow

• Python scripting experience

Project description:
Development of various sensors and actuators within the HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) field. Examples include air differential pressure sensors, air flow sensors, ultrasonic sensors, and variable air valve actuators.
Main responsibilities:
Integration and Abstraction

• You will integrate low-level drivers into higher-level abstractions within modular components in Simulink, following software design requirements and diagrams provided for each feature. Multiple components are then assembled into a complete feature, which is integrated into one of the many products/applications being developed within the project.

Coding and Code Generation:

• Most of the code is written in Matlab (following OOP principles) and Simulink. C++ code generation is used to enable integration with low-level drivers written in C++.

C++ Development:

• A custom C++ code generator has been developed for this project; part of the role involves extending and upgrading it. A strong knowledge of C++ is expected to analyze the generated code and occasionally perform direct modifications in C++.

Main Tasks of the Integrator:

• Creating new products and integrating previously developed features. Finding and fixing bugs/defects. Creating releases and testing functionality on hardware (including specific features, communication protocols, and product parameterization/configuration).

title: Trust Product Manager (Security, Privacy & Compliance | GovTech
description:
Company Overview
Our client builds technology that helps families access public benefits. It also helps governments, health plans and other organizations run those programs more effectively. Their work with state and federal agencies, Medicaid organizations and health plans is growing fast. As it does, trust, security, privacy and compliance have become core product requirements.
Your Role
This is not a typical PM role where compliance is just one feature area. It's also not a policy-only compliance job, and not a pure security engineering seat. We're looking for a trust and compliance expert who is also an excellent product leader . You'll own the strategy and requirements for the company's Trust layer: the platform features that make security, privacy, compliance and auditability part of how the software works. You'll also run the trust and compliance program day to day, and own a company-wide trust transformation. This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role. You'll understand a requirement, work out what it means for the business and the software, bring the right people together, and see the work through.
You’ll:

•
Lead the Trust Transformation

• Own the company's new trust operating model across Product, Engineering, Customer Delivery and company operations.

• Turn regulatory, customer, security and privacy requirements into clear product, technical and operational requirements.

• Partner with the Trust engineering lead to design and build the Trust layer.

• Set durable approaches to production access, data handling, environment separation, release governance and evidence collection.

•
Build Trust Into the Product

•
Own product direction for:

• identity and access management, with least-privilege access

• tenant and environment isolation

• data classification, privacy, consent and data provenance

• audit logging and change history

• retention and data governance

• secure release and deployment controls

• continuous control monitoring

• Move controls out of manual processes and into reusable, software-enforced capabilities, so the compliant path becomes the default path.

•
Own the Trust & Compliance Program

• Maintain policies, controls and evidence in Vanta, and coordinate control owners across the company.

• Own the compliance roadmap and turn new requirements into cross-functional initiatives people can execute.

• Keep a clear view of risks, control gaps, exceptions and remediation commitments.

• Give leadership clear recommendations when trust requirements force business or product trade-offs.

•
Lead Audits, Assurance & Security Programs

• Keep the company continuously ready for recurring SOC 2 audits.

• Coordinate external audits, penetration tests and vendor risk reviews, and drive findings through to closure.

• Launch the NIST 800-series alignment program and help chart the path toward FedRAMP-aligned practices.

•
Be the External Trust Lead

• Act as the main contact for customer security, privacy, compliance and AI-governance requirements.

• Lead responses to security questionnaires, privacy and AI-use assessments, and procurement reviews.

• Represent the company with security, legal and procurement teams at government agencies, Medicaid organizations and health plans.

• Turn recurring customer requirements into reusable controls instead of solving them one customer at a time.

You Bring:

• Significant hands-on experience owning security, privacy, trust, risk or compliance programs inside a software company.

• Experience in regulated environments such as government, public-sector tech, healthcare, Medicaid, health plans or similar high-trust industries.

• Working knowledge of SOC 2, NIST 800-series controls, HIPAA and government security standards.

• A track record of leading audits, security questionnaires, penetration-testing programs and remediation.

• Strong product management skills: problem definition, requirements, prioritization, roadmap ownership and cross-functio

title: Senior Director, Global Order-to-Cash
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Director, Global Order-to-Cash to join our Finance team. This is a Santa Clara, CA hybrid role or U.S.-based remote role, reporting to the VP, Revenue Accounting. You will serve as the global process owner for the complete order-to-cash chain from executable customer order through billing, invoicing, accounts receivable, cash application, credit, collections, disputes, credits and rebills, and cash realization.

This is a strategic process leadership role, not a transactional billing, AR, or collections role. You will be accountable for the global OTC process architecture, control framework, KPI model, transformation agenda, India OTC COE outcomes, and end-to-end operational performance. You will ensure Zscaler operates with one integrated OTC process, one KPI architecture, one transformation roadmap, and one accountable global leader across the customer-facing cash chain.

What You’ll Do - Role Expectations

• Serve as the global process owner for the end-to-end OTC chain, including order management, billing readiness, billing, invoicing, usage/consumption billing, credits and rebills, AR, cash application, credit, collections, disputes, and cash realization.

• Own the global OTC process architecture, operating boundaries, controls, data requirements, KPI framework, transformation roadmap, and performance outcomes across billing accuracy, receivables integrity, DSO, AR aging, cash application, collections, and disputes.

• Provide global leadership to the India OTC COE in partnership with the Director, Order Management & Billing and Director, AR, Credit & Collections, including delegated authority, operating expectations, KPIs, escalation thresholds, evidence standards, and outcome ownership.

• Partner with Sales Operations, Deal Desk, Legal, Provisioning, Product, Pricing, Technical Revenue, Revenue Accounting, Treasury, Controllership, Business Transformation, and IT to improve upstream order quality and prevent downstream billing, AR, and collection issues.

• Lead the OTC transformation agenda, including automation opportunities across order validation, billing readiness, invoicing, credits/rebills, cash application, collections prioritization, dispute routing, exception queues, AR analytics, and human-touch reduction.

- Run team rituals and coordinate initiatives from ideation through final launch in partnership with peers.

- Promote automation, accurate documentation, knowledge sharing, and AI-enabled practices that reduce operational silos and improve service quality.

- Experience leading infrastructure projects involving multiple teams, locations, vendors, and physical dependencies.

- Experience with monitoring, alerting, incident response, troubleshooting, post-incident reviews, and reliability improvement.

Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, highly-available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

The Compute Platform team owns the EKS foundation that Affirm's products run on, from cluster provisioning and lifecycle through the safety standards that keep thousands of workloads reliable at scale. Affirm operates 90+ EKS clusters across environments and regions, and this team is responsible for making that fleet standardized, automated, observable, and self-healing, while establishing and enforcing the workload configuration standards that protect availability. Our mission is to provide a secure, reliable, and scalable Kubernetes platform that lets infrastructure and application teams deploy and operate with confidence and minimal operational friction.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Money Boxes
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

About the role
Money Boxes ("Caixinhas") is one of Nubank’s most strategic product innovations, transforming how millions of customers organize, save, and grow their money across Latin America. As Nubank expands into new geographies and financial verticals, we are looking for an exceptional Senior Staff Software Engineer to serve as the chief technical authority for our Money Boxes core platform.

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of high-concurrency distributed systems, transactional ledgering, investment asset allocation, and liquidity orchestration. You won't just maintain existing product flows-you will architect the foundational engines that enable millions of users to dynamically deposit, segment, and yield return on their savings instantly, securely, and at massive scale.

Your Mission: scale an extensible, multi-tenant Money Boxes platform that abstracts complex investment assets, yield generation mechanisms, and regulatory ledgering into simple, bulletproof platform capabilities across multiple international markets.

What You Will Own & Build

- Money Boxes Platform Architecture: Define and execute the multi-year technical vision for Money Boxes backend architecture, ensuring high extensibility to support diverse underlying assets (e.g., fixed income, yield-bearing accounts, money market funds) across different countries.

title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer, Data Center Equipment
description:
About the Team

OpenAI and its capital and technology partners are building a global network of data centers for demanding AI workloads. The Infrastructure Quality team sets and verifies quality, reliability, and performance requirements for equipment across that network.

We work with manufacturing partners, general contractors, engineers, and operations staff from supplier qualification through commissioning. Together, we verify that equipment arrives ready for installation, startup, and long-term service.

About the Role

As a Manufacturing Quality Engineer, you will oversee the quality of data center equipment at supplier factories. You will use production data, audits, and test results to identify systemic, recurring, or safety-related issues and work with suppliers to address them through Closed Loop Learning (CLL).

You will work with suppliers and internal teams to define inspections and factory tests for each type of equipment. You will coordinate issue resolution before shipment and manage deviations across multiple suppliers and project sites.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Monitoring and Supplier Improvement

- Manufacturing monitoring: Work with Manufacturing Operations to monitor production progress, quality controls, inspection results, and test readiness. Flag emerging risks and coordinate a response with suppliers.

- Product and process audits: Audit products and processes during and after production against engineering requirements, critical-to-quality (CTQ) characteristics, approved procedures, and quality standards. Document findings and track corrective actions to closure.

- Manufacturing coordination: Agree on production checkpoints and inspection and testing requirements with suppliers, engineering, sourcing, supply chain, commissioning, and quality teams. Escalate risks to equipment acceptance or delivery.

- Manufacturing scorecards: Develop supplier and product scorecards with Manufacturing Operations. Review audit findings, test results, recurring defects, and open issues with suppliers to prioritize improvements.

- Drive continuous improvement: Lead the CLL process with suppliers. Track root cause analyses and corrective and preventive actions in a shared register. Verify that each action addresses the underlying problem before closing it.

Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)

- Standardize requirements and formats: Develop product-specific FAT requirements and standard test formats with equipment suppliers and OpenAI’s engineering, commissioning, quality, and Manufacturing Operations teams.

- Define critical quality requirements: Document the CTQ characteristics each test must verify in an OpenAI-accepted format. Use CLL findings to revise FAT procedures so future tests check for known failure modes.

- Ensure auditable supplier records: Require suppliers to retain test results and make them available for OpenAI audits.

- Manage documentation and revision control: Review final FAT records and audit reports for each piece of equipment and maintain a controlled revision history.

- Conduct periodic supplier audits: Check that suppliers follow approved test procedures and that their records accurately reflect the tests performed.

Factory Witness Testing (FWT)

- Align checklists and stakeholders: Develop standard FWT checklists with OpenAI subject matter experts, installing contractors, and the construction management team. Agree on requirements before testing begins.

- Manage documentation and reporting: Collect and review final witness test reports and supporting records from participants.

- Before shipment, confirm that each witness-test issue is resolved or covered by a documented deviation. Log systemic, recurring, or safety-related findings in the CLL tracker and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions with the supplier.
